description: Tests the ability of users to navigate between product categories using the main menu.
steps: Click on the 'MEN' menu link in the navigation bar.
Wait for the Men's category page to load.
Click on the 'WOMEN' menu link in the navigation bar.
Wait for the Women's category page to load.
Click on the 'ACCESSORIES' menu link in the navigation bar.
Wait for the Accessories category page to load.
Verify that each category page displays relevant products.
expected_results: User can successfully navigate between categories.
Navigation menu remains functional throughout the test.
edge_cases: Category menu links are broken or disabled.
Category pages fail to load due to server issues.
Products are missing or incorrectly displayed on category pages.
Navigation menu disappears or becomes unresponsive.
data_requirements: Men, Women, and Accessories categories must exist.
Each category must have products listed.
Category pages must have valid data.
Database must maintain product associations with categories.
dependencies: Navigation menu must be correctly implemented.
Men, Women, and Accessories categories must exist.
Products must be associated with relevant categories.
performance_metrics: Page load time for category pages.
Time taken for category links to redirect.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure that category links have appropriate ARIA roles.
Verify that each category page is keyboard-navigable.
Check for proper color contrast on category pages.
